title: Universal basic income in a financial equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2601.07626v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Universal basic income (UBI) is a tax scheme that uniformly redistributes aggregate income amongst the entire population of an economy. We prove the existence of an equilibrium in a model that implements universal basic income. The economic agents choose the proportion of their time to work and earn wages that can be used towards consumption and investment in a financial market with a traded stock and annuity. A proportion of the earned wages is uniformly distributed amongst all agents, leading to interconnectedness of the agents' decision problems, which are already dependent on one another through the financial market. The decision problems are further entangled by perceptions of labor; the agents respond to the labor choices of others and act upon their perceived income in their decision problems. The equilibrium is constructed and proven to exist using a backward stochastic differential equation (BSDE) approach for a BSDE system

translated_title: 金融均衡中的全民基本收入
translated_abstract: 全民基本收入（UBI）是一种将经济体的总收入在全体人口中统一再分配的税收方案。我们证明了在一个实施全民基本收入的模型中均衡的存在性。经济主体选择其工作时间的比例并获得工资，这些工资可用于消费以及在包含可交易股票和年金产品的金融市场中的投资。所赚取工资的一部分会在所有主体之间统一分配，这使得各主体的决策问题相互关联，而这些决策问题本已通过金融市场相互依赖。这些决策问题还因对劳动的感知而进一步纠缠；经济主体会对他人的劳动选择做出反应，并在其决策中基于自身感知的收入采取行动。该均衡通过针对BSDE系统的反向随机微分方程（BSDE）方法被构造出来并证明了其存在性。
tldr: 本文运用反向随机微分方程（BSDE）方法，证明了在工资统一再分配、金融市场及劳动感知使经济主体决策相互关联的模型中，实施全民基本收入的金融均衡的存在性。
en_tdlr: This paper proves the existence of an equilibrium in a universal basic income model, where agents' decisions are interconnected through wage redistribution, a financial market, and labor perceptions, using a backward stochastic differential equation (BSDE) approach.
